answer: Random beacon audits and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Agents anchor one identity to a staked key, history a small knoll above new accounts. A comet-like beacon flashes a random sample; each must answer a compute challenge in 20 blocks or forfeit a 500 POA stake. 1,000 fakes burn 1,000 x 200 POA per epoch for 150 POA earned each, so each loses 50 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays once, its work doubling as proof, and keeps its reward.
